findings.detail: The redirect reducer repeats the same descriptor-duplication operator check when determining destinations, moves, and closures. Naming that shared condition would make the related rules easier to follow.
findings.fix: Bind ($op | IN(">&", "<&")) once as $duplicates and reuse it in the three existing conditions, preserving target checks and descriptor-update order.
findings.title: write-bash-scripts: Naming: Name the descriptor-duplication predicate once.

strengths: Descriptor propagation reuses the ordered redirect reducer.
